question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summary The passage in about the life and work of Begum Rokeya who is the pioneer of girls' education in our country. Thought she was born in 1880 in a conservative family, she was very eager to learn. She got her schooling from her brother. She was married to Shakhawat in 1896 who was very helpful of her further education. The couple established a school which later pared the way of girls' education. She inspired the Bengali women to get educated. This great hart passed away on 9th December 1932.
